title: The Quiet Between
body:
![preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1296bde372111f2fd05b14af4888f980820c8c0e.png)

# Notice!

I’m excited to share that my Minecraft mod is transitioning from being built in MCreator to a fully custom setup using pure Neoforge. This change allows for much more flexibility, stability, and advanced features in the long run, but it also means that updates will take a bit longer than usual while I rebuild and optimize everything from the ground up. I appreciate your patience and support during this transition, and I can’t wait to bring you the improved experience once it’s ready.

# Description

The Quiet Between is a psychological horror mod that plunges players into a mysterious, unsettling dimension filled with strange structures, interactive entities, and choices that shape the world around them. Explore, uncover secrets, and experience tension-driven gameplay where the environment itself reacts to your actions.

# Features

- Psychological horror mechanics rather than blatant Jumpscares

- Custom Structures

- Interactable entities and events

- Player choices and interactions affecting the environment

# Thing to Note:

- Mod can kick you from the world
  
- Mod **Will** grief your world
  
- Mod **Will** destroy your buildings

> More Might Be added!
